text: When a reviewer reports a file missing from a PR, check git and disk first; it may never have been saved, so re-implement it from the PR description plus the existing CSS and HTML.
In this environment, run git as `git -C <dir>`; `cd <dir> && git ...` triggers an approval prompt and fails in unattended runs.
child-page: the .n-lines SVG uses preserveAspectRatio=none; with vector-effect non-scaling-stroke removed, stroke widths and dasharrays in css/style.css are in viewBox (0-100) units, not pixels.

child-page: activity elements that must be keyboard-accessible need tabindex=0 plus a keydown handler for Enter/Space alongside pointerdown, and a :focus-visible outline in css/style.css; position dynamic nodes in percent so they survive orientation changes.
child-page: for keyboard activation of pointerdown-wired buttons, add a click listener guarded by e.detail === 0 (Enter/Space) and remove both listeners in the mount cleanup.

Reworker: the revisions-required label may show as 'revisions-required:wip' claim label; `gh pr edit --remove-label revisions-required` still works. child-page has no test suite, so verify JS with `node --check`.

child-page: don't rely on SVG pathLength with stroke-dasharray for line-draw effects (unreliable across browsers); set the real length via a --len CSS variable computed in JS and use it for dasharray/dashoffset.

Reworker: `git merge` fails in this env without an identity; export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL (and GIT_AUTHOR_*) before merging main into a PR branch, then finish with `gh-as-agent commit` and `gh-as-agent push --repo <clone>` run from inside the clone dir.

child-page: activities mount inside .stage, and the global `.stage svg {width:120px;height:120px}` rule (specificity 0,1,1) overrides single-class SVG sizing like .n-lines; scope activity SVG overlay selectors as `.stage .<class>` or they shrink to 120px and misalign with percent-positioned elements.

Reworker: an add/add conflict on a stacked PR's file means main already holds an older copy; keep the PR's newer version with `git checkout --ours <file>` during `git merge origin/main`, then re-check `gh pr view --json mergeable` after a few seconds because GitHub's status lags.

child-page: for SVG parts that must scale around a fixed point (e.g. butterfly wings folding to the body axis), set the SVG transform attribute (scale about user-space origin) from JS; CSS transform-box: view-box with transform-origin percentages ignores an offset viewBox (e.g. -50 -40 100 80) and folds toward the wrong side.

child-page playtime.js: when a localStorage write fails, keep an in-memory copy of state and have load() use it (storageOk flag) so refresh-from-storage doesn't discard used time; guard once-only expiry rendering with a per-start flag in app.js.

child-page: Playtime.start() calls stop() which cancels fades, so in app.js render() call Playtime.start(cb) before Playtime.renderLater(stage); set the shownLater flag before start() since the expiry callback only fires on a later tick.

Reworker: labels like `<outcome>:wip` and `<outcome>:completed` (e.g. ready-for-review:completed, revisions-required:completed) are platform claim/tracking labels set on flow transitions; agents don't manage them, and a human may remove leftovers manually.

child-page playtime.js: paint() must not set stage opacity to 1 at progress >= 1, because the expiry tick calls paint() before onExpire/renderLater reads the current opacity; setting 1 there makes the moon fade jump to full brightness first.

child-page: tap targets for small floating elements (e.g. the day/night bird) need both width and min-height >= 48px; make the button display:flex; align-items:center so the SVG stays centred without changing its drawn size.

child-page Day/Night (js/dzien-i-noc.js): the cloud/bird/night-flyer logic all runs from one rAF loop (cloudTick); night flyers (satellite, blinking airplane) are .dn-fly divs inside .dn-stars, spawned only when progress>=0.95 and target===1, so they fade with the sky and work under prefers-reduced-motion.

Reworker: 'Night Sky' in human feedback can mean either Nocne Niebo (js/niebo.js, star-connecting game) or Day/Night (js/dzien-i-noc.js, whose Big Dipper was the only constellation); when ambiguous, post a blocking PR comment + human-decision-required and aee-ask before editing.

child-page Day/Night: stars added over time are JS-grown (starTick in the shared rAF loop, 1px -> target via smoothstep, transform translate(-50%,-50%) so they grow around their centre) instead of CSS animation, so they survive prefers-reduced-motion; total star count is capped (STAR_CAP).

Reworker: a human PR comment like 'Implement optional suggestions' makes the reviewer's optional suggestions mandatory; the local clone may sit on another branch, so fetch and `git checkout -b
origin/
`, and `git add` before `gh-as-agent commit` (it doesn't stage).

Reworker: a stacked PR's base branch is another feature branch (check `gh pr view --json baseRefName`); resolve 'merge conflicts' by merging origin/<base> into the PR branch (with GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER env set, `git -C <dir>` form only; chained `&&` with checkout/merge triggers an approval prompt), keeping the PR's own side for the contested hunk.
child-page deszczyk.js: rainTotal (time toward the next rainbow) only accumulates while bowState === 0 and is reset when a rainbow starts, so rain during a rainbow doesn't chain a second one.

child-page pociag.js station-stop: cap Hermite duration T at 2.85*D/v (monotone while v*T<=3D) and add a lap only if T would be <2.5s; layout() re-plans an active stop via goStation() so resize doesn't snap.

child-page: sibling activity PRs stacked on feature/menu-scroll-28 all append to the same spots (js/activities.js list end, script tags before app.js, end of css/style.css), so merge conflicts between them are additive: keep both sides, then re-add the trailing comma on the former last activities.js entry and run node --check on every js file.

Reworker: when a human says 'implement the optional suggestions' and one is manual device testing, fix the code ones, post a blocking comment and apply human-decision-required rather than ready-for-review.

Reworker: for 'implement optional suggestions' on activity PRs, the 'confirm on a device' item is manual; do the code ones, post a blocking comment and apply human-decision-required (not ready-for-review).

Reworker: the hand-off gate holds ready-for-review back when a PR conflicts with its base ('Hand-off held back: merge conflict'), re-setting revisions-required; fix by merging origin/<base>, then re-add ready-for-review and remove stale revisions-required:completed.

child-page banki.js: Back-button/hourglass keep-out is measured each frame from document.querySelector('.back'/'.hourglass') rects (+12px pad) instead of a fixed pixel corner, so safe-area insets and the optional hourglass are handled; tiny bubbles (r <= MIN_R*1.2) fade on touch rather than ignore it.

Reworker: before `git merge` check the current branch with `git branch --show-current`; a failed `checkout -b` (branch already exists) leaves you on the previous branch, and the merge then fast-forwards the wrong one. Use `checkout
` + `reset --hard origin/
` for a stale local branch, and re-fetch the base right before pushing because sibling activity PRs keep landing on it.

Reworker: in this sandbox `cd <repo> && git ...` triggers an approval prompt; use `git -C <dir>` and run python/grep from another cwd. A regex over conflict markers (keep both sides, append our entry last with comma fix) resolves additive activity-PR conflicts quickly.
child-page: CSS class prefixes are shared globally; Policz Razem owns .pr/.pr-board/.pr-btn/.pr-glow, so new activities need a distinct prefix (Przeciwieństwa uses pw-).

Reworker: child-page SVG activities that render two copies of the same SVG (e.g. reduced-motion cross-fade) must give clipPath/gradient ids a per-copy suffix, since duplicate ids in one document are invalid.

Reworker: in this sandbox `git merge` needs an identity; use `git -C <dir> -c user.name=<agent> -c user.email=<agent>@agents.local merge --no-commit origin/main`, resolve, then commit with the same -c flags.

Reworker: child-page activity PRs targeting main keep conflicting as siblings merge (each appends to the same README/CSS/index.html/activities.js spots); after resolving, renumber the README item and the intro count word to match the merged base before pushing.

Reworker: when resolving activity-PR conflicts with a regex keep-both script, check for a missing comma after the previous last entry in js/activities.js (node --check catches it) and bump the README intro count word (e.g. sixteen -> seventeen) and item number.

Reworker: a revisions-required wake caused only by the hand-off gate's 'merge conflict with main' comment has no review feedback; just merge origin/main, keep both sides, put the new activity last (comma fix), and bump the README count word and item number.

Reworker: the hand-off gate's 'merge conflict with main' revisions-required wakes on child-page activity PRs recur as siblings merge; each is resolved by merging origin/main, keeping both sides with our entry last and bumping the README count word and item number.

Reworker: an 'Implement optional suggestions' comment on a child-page activity PR whose only optional ask is manual device testing means: resolve any merge conflict, then apply human-decision-required (not ready-for-review) and ask a human to record device results.

Reworker: for activity-PR merge conflicts a python re.sub keep-both resolver works (CSS/index.html: main's side first, ours last; activities.js: add a comma after main's last entry); then bump the README intro count word and item number.

Reworker: after a regex keep-both conflict resolve on a child-page activity PR, the new entry can land mid-list in js/activities.js and index.html (our side sits before sibling entries); move it to the very end and fix the comma before pushing.

Reworker: when 'Implement optional suggestions' also mentions a stale PR body count (e.g. 'entry 15/fifteen'), fix it with gh pr edit --body-file after the conflict merge so it matches the final README item number and count word.

Reworker: a keep-both conflict resolve on child-page's README can leave two intro lines (HEAD and main versions both survive when the conflict isn't marked); after merging, check the first lines of README.md for a duplicate intro and the highest item number on main before numbering your own.

Reworker: right after a cleanup sweep that removes ':completed'/':wip' tracking labels, a freshly added human-decision-required label can disappear; always re-check `gh pr view --json labels` after a few seconds and re-add it if missing.

Reworker: to keep human-decision-required from being dropped, strip the ':completed'/':wip' tracking labels first, wait a few seconds, then add human-decision-required and verify with gh pr view --json labels.

Reworker: child-page activity-PR conflict wakes keep recurring; the python re.sub keep-both resolver (theirs first, ours last, comma fix in activities.js, README intro line taken from main) works in one pass, then set README count word and item number to main's highest + 1.

Reworker: when the Code Reviewer hands a child-page PR back unreviewed only for a merge conflict, the right outcome after resolving it is ready-for-review (a full review has not happened yet), unlike the 'Implement optional suggestions' device-test case which uses human-decision-required.
